title: Lab
heading: Lab
intro: A small playground of interactive experiments. Click, tap, chase a score — spend a minute for fun.
leaveConfirm: Leave the game? Your current run will be lost.

paw.title: Paw Rush
paw.blurb: Thirty seconds. Hit the targets. Chase the combo.
paw.hint: Tap or click targets before they fade. Best score is saved per difficulty.

hoot.title: Hoot Stack
hoot.blurb: Slide owlets. Merge matching hoots. Chase the big HOOT.
hoot.hint: Arrow keys or swipe. Same voices merge into the next. Best score is saved.
